# Nivora Works

> Nivora is a software and AI studio in Brugge, Belgium. It builds its own apps, Box (in closed beta at box.nivoraworks.com, opening soon) and Voice (in development), and designs custom software and AI systems for companies: bespoke apps, local (on-premise) AI installations, AI operating systems and AI consulting.

Nivora (also written as Nivora Works or NivoraWorks) works with companies that want intelligent systems built around how they actually operate, with a strong focus on data privacy: its Local AI service runs powerful AI models on the customer's own servers so data never leaves the building.

## Products

- [Box](https://box.nivoraworks.com/): finished and in closed beta, opening soon. Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in one calm inbox, with AI that says which messages are actually waiting on a reply and drafts the answer in your own tone. Telegram, Slack and LinkedIn are planned. Pricing is not published yet. Ask for early access on the site.
- [Voice](https://nivoraworks.com/waitlist?product=voice): turns the way you talk into finished, well-formatted text in your own style. Still in development, waiting list open.

## Services

- [App Design & Development](https://nivoraworks.com/services/app-design): consumer apps, business tools and complex builds, designed from the ground up.
- [Local AI](https://nivoraworks.com/services/local-ai): full AI capability on your own servers; data stays in-house, no subscriptions.
- [AIOS](https://nivoraworks.com/services/aios): an AI operating system tuned to your company that takes on admin, marketing, finance and support work.
- [AI Consulting](https://nivoraworks.com/services/ai-consulting): mapping where AI genuinely pays off and implementing it with your team.

## Sectors

Nivora works in three trades and says no to the rest, so the work in each one goes deep enough to be worth buying.

- [Estate agencies](https://nivoraworks.com/ai-automation-estate-agency): what is known about a property before it changes hands, gathered from the official Flemish sources instead of by hand.
- [Architecture practices](https://nivoraworks.com/ai-automation-architect): the evidence file for a plot, its two governing dates, and what the regulations literally said, out of one address.
- [Logistics](https://nivoraworks.com/ai-automation-logistics): forwarding, customs, ship agency and bonded warehousing around the Flemish ports. Alongside CargoWise, Descartes, IDMS, AES and Certified Pick up, never between you and the authorities.

## Frequently asked

What does Nivora do? Nivora builds and installs custom AI systems for companies, from private (local) AI inside your own infrastructure to custom apps and complete AI operating systems, and it makes its own software, Box and Voice.

Where is Nivora based? Nivora is a software and AI studio in Brugge, Belgium, working with companies across Belgium and the Netherlands.

Is my data safe with local AI? Yes. Local AI runs inside your own infrastructure, so your data never leaves your servers. Everything is GDPR-ready and the systems Nivora builds are fully yours to keep.

Who founded Nivora? Nivora was founded by Kamiel Niville.

Is Box available now? Almost. Box is built and running in a closed beta at https://box.nivoraworks.com, where you can ask for early access and join the waiting list. Nivora is finishing the security work first, because Box reads your mail and your WhatsApp; part of that is an independent review by Google for full Gmail access and a review by Meta for Instagram and Messenger. No public date is announced yet. It connects Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp today; Instagram and Messenger are built and waiting on Meta's approval; Telegram, Slack and LinkedIn are planned.

How can I contact Nivora? Email kamiel@nivoraworks.com or call +32 489 00 77 37. Nivora usually replies within a day.
